# Current follow-up trace

After the breakfast, the founder submits a sanitized activation receipt. Gabriel reads the receipt,
checks the missing evidence role and manually writes a D1 message. The message must name only one
next action. Drafting and checking a batch currently takes about 18 minutes.

The founder then returns to the same local brain folder on D3. The desired final output is a short,
specific follow-up that points to the next real case and does not request all company sources.
